name: Star nest
description: Flight through an infinite lattice of star clusters. Space is folded into a repeating tile and each sample is run through an inversion fractal; what is accumulated is the total change in orbit radius, which spikes into points of light. Volumetric, so the clusters pass through one another as you fly.

tile.description: Size of the repeating fold. Small values pack the clusters tighter.

darkmatter.description: Occlusion by the dense regions, which is what stops the far field washing out flat.
